POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS.description: Initialization options applied only to an empty database volume. Keep locale and encoding compatible with the application.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKERS.description: One CPU inference worker initially. No GPU is configured.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

DB_HOSTNAME.description: Db hostname resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DB_PORT.description: Db port for immich. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_USERNAME.description: Db username for immich. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_PASSWORD.description: Db password resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DB_DATABASE_NAME.description: Db database name for immich. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

REDIS_HOSTNAME.description: Redis hostname resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

IMMICH_CONFIG_FILE.description: Generated at startup to configure the private machine-learning service.

MACHINE_LEARNING_URL.description: Machine learning url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
